title: No multiply, no divide
description:
Write two functions without `imul`, `mul`, `div` or `idiv`:

| Function | Returns |
|---|---|
| `times10(x)` | `x × 10`, with `lea` (and `add` or `shl` if you like) |
| `div8(x)` | `x / 8` for a **signed** `x`, rounding towards zero like C (so −9 / 8 is −1) |

starter.solution.asm:
times10:
        imul    rax, rdi, 10
        ret

div8:
        mov     rax, rdi
        sar     rax, 3
        ret

solution.solution.asm:
times10:
        lea     rax, [rdi + rdi*4]
        add     rax, rax
        ret

div8:
        mov     rax, rdi
        sar     rax, 63
        and     rax, 7
        add     rax, rdi
        sar     rax, 3
        ret

hints: `lea rax, [rdi + rdi*4]` is five times `rdi`; doubling that gives ten (lesson 8.02).
`sar` alone rounds down (−9 becomes −2). Adding 7 first when the number is negative fixes it: `sar rax, 63` gives all ones for a negative number, and `and` with 7 turns that into 7 or 0.
rules: Do not use multiply or divide instructions.
unitTests:
test "times ten"
    times10(7) == 70
    times10(0) == 0
    times10(-3) == -30
    times10(123456789) == 1234567890
test "signed divide by eight"
    div8(64) == 8
    div8(70) == 8
    div8(-9) == -1
    div8(-8) == -1
    div8(-7) == 0
    div8(-64) == -8
